svg.text: APPLICATION + CONNECTORS / Render · three Starter services
Approved follow-ups → send eligibility check → channel
Development: API + Ollama on host; Docker Compose runs WAHA + Temporal.
Hosted: app / embedded worker + private WAHA + private Temporal; Tiger stays external.
Incoming batches reach inference directly; Tiger persistence runs alongside analysis. Validated results update the shared calendar.
AI never sends on its own. Replies are owner-reviewed; scheduled sends require an unchanged task, conversation and approval.
